verses.original: Τῇ δὲ μιᾷ τῶν σαββάτων Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ ἔρχεται πρωῒ σκοτίας ἔτι οὔσης εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον καὶ βλέπει τὸν λίθον ἠρμένον ἐκ τοῦ μνημείου
verses.transliteration: Tē de mia tōn sabbatōn Maria hē Magdalēnē erchetai prōi skotias eti ousēs eis to mnēmeion kai blepei ton lithon ērmenon ek tou mnēmeiou
verses.literal: Early on the first day of the week while it was still dark Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance
verses.literalPt: No primeiro dia da semana, Maria Madalena foi cedo ao túmulo, sendo ainda escuro, e viu a pedra removida.

verses.original: τρέχει οὖν καὶ ἔρχεται πρὸς Σίμωνα Πέτρον καὶ πρὸς τὸν ἄλλον μαθητὴν ὃν ἐφίλει ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἦραν τὸν Κύριον ἐκ τοῦ μνημείου καὶ οὐκ οἴδαμεν ποῦ ἔθηκαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: trechei oun kai erchetai pros Simōna Petron kai pros ton allon mathētēn hon ephilei ho Iēsous kai legei autois Ēran ton Kyrion ek tou mnēmeiou kai ouk oidamen pou ethēkan auton
verses.literal: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple the one whom Jesus loved They have taken the Lord out of the tomb she said and we do not know where they have put Him
verses.literalPt: Correu ela, e foi ter com Simão Pedro e com o outro discípulo a quem Jesus amava, e disse-lhes: Tiraram do túmulo o Senhor, e não sabemos onde o puseram.

verses.original: Ἐξῆλθεν οὖν ὁ Πέτρος καὶ ὁ ἄλλος μαθητής καὶ ἤρχοντο εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον
verses.transliteration: Exēlthen oun ho Petros kai ho allos mathētēs kai ērchonto eis to mnēmeion
verses.literal: Then Peter and the other disciple set out . . . . . . for the tomb
verses.literalPt: Então, saíram Pedro e o outro discípulo e foram ao túmulo.

verses.original: ἔτρεχον δὲ οἱ δύο ὁμοῦ καὶ ὁ ἄλλος μαθητὴς προέδραμεν τάχιον τοῦ Πέτρου καὶ ἦλθεν πρῶτος εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον
verses.transliteration: etrechon de hoi dyo homou kai ho allos mathētēs proedramen tachion tou Petrou kai ēlthen prōtos eis to mnēmeion
verses.literal: The two were running together but the other disciple outran . . . Peter and reached . . . the tomb first
verses.literalPt: Corriam ambos juntos, mas o outro discípulo correu mais ligeiro do que Pedro e chegou primeiro ao túmulo;

verses.original: καὶ παρακύψας βλέπει κείμενα τὰ ὀθόνια οὐ μέντοι εἰσῆλθεν
verses.transliteration: kai parakypsas blepei keimena ta othonia ou mentoi eisēlthen
verses.literal: He bent down and looked in at the linen cloths lying there but he did not go in
verses.literalPt: tendo-se abaixado e olhando para dentro, viu os panos de linho postos no chão, porém não entrou.

verses.original: Ἔρχεται οὖν καὶ Σίμων Πέτρος ἀκολουθῶν αὐτῷ καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον καὶ θεωρεῖ τὰ ὀθόνια κείμενα
verses.transliteration: Erchetai oun kai Simōn Petros akolouthōn autō kai eisēlthen eis to mnēmeion kai theōrei ta othonia keimena
verses.literal: Simon Peter arrived just after him He entered . . . the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying there
verses.literalPt: Chegou Simão Pedro, que o seguia, e entrou no túmulo. Ele também viu os panos de linho e o lenço

verses.original: καὶ τὸ σουδάριον ὃ ἦν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ οὐ μετὰ τῶν ὀθονίων κείμενον ἀλλὰ χωρὶς ἐντετυλιγμένον εἰς ἕνα τόπον
verses.transliteration: kai to soudarion ho ēn epi tēs kephalēs autou ou meta tōn othoniōn keimenon alla chōris entetyligmenon eis hena topon
verses.literal: The cloth that had been around Jesus’ head was rolled up lying separate . . . from the linen cloths
verses.literalPt: que estivera sobre a cabeça de Jesus e que não estava com os panos, mas dobrado num lugar à parte.

verses.original: τότε οὖν εἰσῆλθεν καὶ ὁ ἄλλος μαθητὴς ὁ ἐλθὼν πρῶτος εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἐπίστευσεν
verses.transliteration: tote oun eisēlthen kai ho allos mathētēs ho elthōn prōtos eis to mnēmeion kai eiden kai episteusen
verses.literal: Then . . . the other disciple who had reached . . . the tomb first also went in And he saw and believed
verses.literalPt: Então, entrou também o outro discípulo, que tinha chegado primeiro ao túmulo, e viu, e creu.

verses.original: οὐδέπω γὰρ ᾔδεισαν τὴν γραφὴν ὅτι δεῖ αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναστῆναι
verses.transliteration: oudepō gar ēdeisan tēn graphēn hoti dei auton ek nekrōn anastēnai
verses.literal: For they still did not understand from the Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead
verses.literalPt: Pois ainda não compreendiam a Escritura, que era necessário ressuscitar ele dentre os mortos.

verses.original: Ἀπῆλθον οὖν πάλιν πρὸς αὑτοὺς οἱ μαθηταί
verses.transliteration: Apēlthon oun palin pros hautous hoi mathētai
verses.literal: Then the disciples returned . . . to their homes
verses.literalPt: E voltaram os discípulos para casa.

verses.original: Μαρία δὲ εἱστήκει πρὸς τῷ μνημείῳ ἔξω κλαίουσα ὡς οὖν ἔκλαιεν παρέκυψεν εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον
verses.transliteration: Maria de heistēkei pros tō mnēmeiō exō klaiousa hōs oun eklaien parekypsen eis to mnēmeion
verses.literal: But Mary stood outside the tomb weeping And as she wept she bent down to look into the tomb
verses.literalPt: Maria, porém, estava junto à entrada do túmulo, chorando. Enquanto chorava, abaixou-se, e olhou para dentro do túmulo,

verses.original: καὶ θεωρεῖ δύο ἀγγέλους ἐν λευκοῖς καθεζομένους ἕνα πρὸς τῇ κεφαλῇ καὶ ἕνα πρὸς τοῖς ποσίν ὅπου ἔκειτο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai theōrei dyo angelous en leukois kathezomenous hena pros tē kephalē kai hena pros tois posin hopou ekeito to sōma tou Iēsou
verses.literal: and she saw two angels in white sitting where the body of Jesus had lain one at the head and the other at the feet
verses.literalPt: e viu dois anjos com vestes brancas, sentados onde o corpo de Jesus fora posto, um à cabeceira e outro aos pés.

verses.original: Καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῇ ἐκεῖνοι Γύναι τί κλαίεις Λέγει αὐτοῖς Ὅτι Ἦραν τὸν Κύριόν μου καὶ οὐκ οἶδα ποῦ ἔθηκαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai legousin autē ekeinoi Gynai ti klaieis Legei autois Hoti Ēran ton Kyrion mou kai ouk oida pou ethēkan auton
verses.literal: Woman why are you weeping they asked Because they have taken my Lord away she said . . . and I do not know where they have put Him
verses.literalPt: Eles lhe perguntaram: Mulher, por que choras? Respondeu ela: Porque tiraram o meu Senhor, e não sei onde o puseram.

verses.original: Ταῦτα εἰποῦσα ἐστράφη εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ θεωρεῖ τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἑστῶτα καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Tauta eipousa estraphē eis ta opisō kai theōrei ton Iēsoun hestōta kai ouk ēdei hoti Iēsous estin
verses.literal: When she had said this she turned . . . around and saw Jesus standing there But she did not recognize that it was Jesus
verses.literalPt: Tendo dito isso, virou-se para trás e viu a Jesus em pé, mas sem saber que era ele.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῇ Ἰησοῦς Γύναι τί κλαίεις τίνα ζητεῖς Ἐκείνη δοκοῦσα ὅτι ὁ κηπουρός ἐστιν λέγει αὐτῷ Κύριε εἰ σὺ ἐβάστασας αὐτόν εἰπέ μοι ποῦ ἔθηκας αὐτόν κἀγὼ αὐτὸν ἀρῶ
verses.transliteration: legei autē Iēsous Gynai ti klaieis tina zēteis Ekeinē dokousa hoti ho kēpouros estin legei autō Kyrie ei sy ebastasas auton eipe moi pou ethēkas auton kagō auton arō
verses.literal: Woman why are you weeping Jesus asked Whom are you seeking Thinking He was the gardener she said . . . Sir if you have carried Him off . . . tell me where you have put Him and I will get Him . . .
verses.literalPt: Perguntou-lhe Jesus: Mulher, por que choras? A quem procuras? Ela, supondo ser ele o jardineiro, respondeu: Senhor, se tu o tiraste, dize-me onde o puseste, e eu o levarei.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῇ Ἰησοῦς Μαριάμ Στραφεῖσα ἐκείνη λέγει αὐτῷ Ἑβραϊστί Ραββουνι ὃ λέγεται Διδάσκαλε
verses.transliteration: Legei autē Iēsous Mariam Strapheisa ekeinē legei autō Hebraisti Rabbouni ho legetai Didaskale
verses.literal: Jesus said to her Mary She turned and said to Him in Hebrew Rabboni ( which means “Teacher” )
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Maria! Ela, virando-se, lhe disse em hebraico: Rabôni! (que quer dizer, Mestre).

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῇ Ἰησοῦς Μή μου ἅπτου οὔπω γὰρ ἀναβέβηκα πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα πορεύου δὲ πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφούς μου καὶ εἰπὲ αὐτοῖς Ἀναβαίνω πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα μου καὶ Πατέρα ὑμῶν καὶ Θεόν μου καὶ Θεὸν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Legei autē Iēsous Mē mou haptou oupō gar anabebēka pros ton Patera poreuou de pros tous adelphous mou kai eipe autois Anabainō pros ton Patera mou kai Patera hymōn kai Theon mou kai Theon hymōn
verses.literal: Do not cling to Me Jesus said for I have not yet ascended to the Father But go and tell My brothers I am ascending to My Father and your Father to My God and your God
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Não me toques; porque ainda não subi ao Pai, mas vai a meus irmãos e dize-lhes que subo para meu Pai e vosso Pai, para meu Deus e vosso Deus.

verses.original: Ἔρχεται Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ ἀγγέλλουσα τοῖς μαθηταῖς ὅτι Ἑώρακα τὸν Κύριον καὶ ταῦτα εἶπεν αὐτῇ
verses.transliteration: Erchetai Mariam hē Magdalēnē angellousa tois mathētais hoti Heōraka ton Kyrion kai tauta eipen autē
verses.literal: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples I have seen the Lord And she told them what He had said to her
verses.literalPt: Maria Madalena foi contar aos discípulos: Vi o Senhor, e ele disse-me essas coisas.

verses.original: Οὔσης οὖν ὀψίας τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ τῇ μιᾷ σαββάτων καὶ τῶν θυρῶν κεκλεισμένων ὅπου ἦσαν οἱ μαθηταὶ διὰ τὸν φόβον τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἔστη εἰς τὸ μέσον καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Ousēs oun opsias tē hēmera ekeinē tē mia sabbatōn kai tōn thyrōn kekleismenōn hopou ēsan hoi mathētai dia ton phobon tōn Ioudaiōn ēlthen ho Iēsous kai estē eis to meson kai legei autois Eirēnē hymin
verses.literal: It was the first day of the week and that very evening while the disciples were together with the doors locked for fear of the Jews Jesus came and stood among them Peace be with you He said to them
verses.literalPt: Nesse dia, que era o primeiro da semana, à tarde, trancadas as portas da casa onde se achavam os discípulos, por medo que tinham dos judeus, veio Jesus, e pôs-se no meio deles, e disse-lhes: Paz seja convosco!

verses.original: καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν ἔδειξεν καὶ τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τὴν πλευρὰν αὐτοῖς Ἐχάρησαν οὖν οἱ μαθηταὶ ἰδόντες τὸν Κύριον
verses.transliteration: kai touto eipōn edeixen kai tas cheiras kai tēn pleuran autois Echarēsan oun hoi mathētai idontes ton Kyrion
verses.literal: After He had said this He showed them His hands and His side The disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord
verses.literalPt: Dito isso, mostrou-lhes as mãos e o lado. Os discípulos alegraram-se muito ao verem o Senhor.

verses.original: Εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς πάλιν Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν καθὼς ἀπέσταλκέν με ὁ Πατήρ κἀγὼ πέμπω ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Eipen oun autois ho Iēsous palin Eirēnē hymin kathōs apestalken me ho Patēr kagō pempō hymas
verses.literal: Again Jesus said to them Peace be with you As the Father has sent Me . . . so also I am sending you
verses.literalPt: Jesus, de novo, disse-lhes: Paz seja convosco! Como o Pai me enviou a mim, assim eu vos envio a vós.

verses.original: καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν ἐνεφύσησεν καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Λάβετε Πνεῦμα Ἅγιον
verses.transliteration: kai touto eipōn enephysēsen kai legei autois Labete Pneuma Hagion
verses.literal: When He had said this He breathed on them and said . . . Receive the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: Dito isso, soprou sobre eles e disse-lhes: Recebei o Espírito Santo.

verses.original: ἄν τινων ἀφῆτε τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἀφέωνται αὐτοῖς ἄν τινων κρατῆτε κεκράτηνται
verses.transliteration: an tinōn aphēte tas hamartias apheōntai autois an tinōn kratēte kekratēntai
verses.literal: If you forgive anyone his sins they are forgiven . . . if you withhold forgiveness from anyone it is withheld
verses.literalPt: Àqueles a quem perdoardes os pecados, lhes serão perdoados; e àqueles a quem os retiverdes, lhes serão retidos.

verses.original: Θωμᾶς δὲ εἷς ἐκ τῶν δώδεκα ὁ λεγόμενος Δίδυμος οὐκ ἦν μετ’ αὐτῶν ὅτε ἦλθεν Ἰησοῦς
verses.transliteration: Thōmas de heis ek tōn dōdeka ho legomenos Didymos ouk ēn met’ autōn hote ēlthen Iēsous
verses.literal: Now Thomas called Didymus one of the Twelve was not with the disciples when Jesus came
verses.literalPt: Porém Tomé, chamado Dídimo, um dos doze, não estava com eles quando veio Jesus.

verses.original: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ οἱ ἄλλοι μαθηταί Ἑωράκαμεν τὸν Κύριον Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἐὰν μὴ ἴδω ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ τὸν τύπον τῶν ἥλων καὶ βάλω τὸν δάκτυλόν μου εἰς τὸν τύπον τῶν ἥλων καὶ βάλω μου τὴν χεῖρα εἰς τὴν πλευρὰν αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ πιστεύσω
verses.transliteration: elegon oun autō hoi alloi mathētai Heōrakamen ton Kyrion Ho de eipen autois Ean mē idō en tais chersin autou ton typon tōn hēlōn kai balō ton daktylon mou eis ton typon tōn hēlōn kai balō mou tēn cheira eis tēn pleuran autou ou mē pisteusō
verses.literal: So the other disciples told him We have seen the Lord But he replied . . . Unless . . . I see the nail marks in His hands and put my finger where the - nails have been and put my hand into His side I will never believe
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe os outros discípulos: Vimos o Senhor. Mas ele respondeu: Se eu não vir nas suas mãos o sinal dos cravos, e não puser o meu dedo no lugar dos cravos, e não puser a minha mão no seu lado, de modo algum hei de crer.

verses.original: Καὶ μεθ’ ἡμέρας ὀκτὼ πάλιν ἦσαν ἔσω οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ Θωμᾶς μετ’ αὐτῶν ἔρχεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῶν θυρῶν κεκλεισμένων καὶ ἔστη εἰς τὸ μέσον καὶ εἶπεν Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Kai meth’ hēmeras oktō palin ēsan esō hoi mathētai autou kai Thōmas met’ autōn erchetai ho Iēsous tōn thyrōn kekleismenōn kai estē eis to meson kai eipen Eirēnē hymin
verses.literal: Eight days later His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked and Thomas was with them Jesus came and stood among them and said Peace be with you
verses.literalPt: Oito dias depois, estavam outra vez ali reunidos seus discípulos, e Tomé, com eles. Estando as portas trancadas, veio Jesus, pôs-se em pé no meio deles e disse: Paz seja convosco!

verses.original: εἶτα λέγει τῷ Θωμᾷ Φέρε τὸν δάκτυλόν σου ὧδε καὶ ἴδε τὰς χεῖράς μου καὶ φέρε τὴν χεῖρά σου καὶ βάλε εἰς τὴν πλευράν μου καὶ μὴ γίνου ἄπιστος ἀλλὰ πιστός
verses.transliteration: eita legei tō Thōma Phere ton daktylon sou hōde kai ide tas cheiras mou kai phere tēn cheira sou kai bale eis tēn pleuran mou kai mē ginou apistos alla pistos
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to Thomas Put your finger here and look at My hands Reach out your hand and put it into My side Stop doubting and believe
verses.literalPt: Em seguida, disse a Tomé: Chega aqui o teu dedo e olha as minhas mãos; chega também a tua mão e põe-na no meu lado; não sejas incrédulo, mas crente.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Θωμᾶς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ὁ Κύριός μου καὶ ὁ Θεός μου
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Thōmas kai eipen autō Ho Kyrios mou kai ho Theos mou
verses.literal: Thomas replied . . . . . . . . . My Lord and my God
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Tomé: Senhor meu e Deus meu!

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ὅτι ἑώρακάς με πεπίστευκας μακάριοι οἱ μὴ ἰδόντες καὶ πιστεύσαντες
verses.transliteration: Legei autō ho Iēsous Hoti heōrakas me pepisteukas makarioi hoi mē idontes kai pisteusantes
verses.literal: Jesus said to him Because you have seen Me you have believed blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Creste, porque me viste? Bem-aventurados os que não viram e creram.

verses.original: Πολλὰ μὲν οὖν καὶ ἄλλα σημεῖα ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐνώπιον τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἃ οὐκ ἔστιν γεγραμμένα ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ
verses.transliteration: Polla men oun kai alla sēmeia epoiēsen ho Iēsous enōpion tōn mathētōn autou ha ouk estin gegrammena en tō bibliō toutō
verses.literal: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples which are not written in this book
verses.literalPt: Jesus fez na presença dos discípulos muitos outros sinais, que não estão escritos neste livro;

verses.original: ταῦτα δὲ γέγραπται ἵνα πιστεύητε ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἵνα πιστεύοντες ζωὴν ἔχητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: tauta de gegraptai hina pisteuēte hoti Iēsous estin ho Christos ho Huios tou Theou kai hina pisteuontes zōēn echēte en tō onomati autou
verses.literal: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ the Son of God and that by believing you may have life in His name
verses.literalPt: estes, porém, estão escritos para que creiais que Jesus é o Cristo, o Filho de Deus, e para que, crendo, tenhais vida em seu nome.
